subject: social_studies
concept: Applying conformity, in-group/out-group dynamics, bystander effect, cognitive bias, and persuasion awareness to a real-world scenario, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student analyzes a realistic social scenario for signs of conformity, bias, or persuasion at work
exercise.abstract: Student explains what social psychology concept from this unit best explains the scenario, and what a more thoughtful response might look like

assessment.mastery_threshold: correctly identifies at least one relevant concept and proposes a genuinely more thoughtful response
misconception_flags: identifies a concept but cannot connect it to any concrete alternative response

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
